description: Memory-efficient executable single-Spark Candidate for one-or-two-reference Qwen Image Edit 2511 jobs, using Comfy-Org's official stock-ComfyUI INT8 tensorwise ConvRot transformer, scaled-FP8 Qwen-VL encoder, and Qwen Image VAE. It pins the official non-turbo 40-step workflow and declares a conservative 108.00 GB unified-memory admission envelope including reserve and 95.14 GB peak installation disk; physical Spark quality, latency, and peak-memory acceptance remain pending.
title: Qwen Image Edit 2511 INT8 ConvRot ComfyUI single Spark
